author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/45-ml-classifier.md — REQ-8, AC-7 + decomposition PR 6.

## Surface
- Extend `ClassifierClient` trait with `feedback()` method (already shape-defined in #126).
- New module: `polaris-backend/src/classifier/feedback.rs` — gates feedback emission behind per-classifier `send_feedback` flag.
- Hook into the v1 action-emission path (`polaris-backend/src/api/cases.rs::submit_action`): after a successful action, if any classifier signal contributed to the case AND `send_feedback = true` for that classifier, emit a `Feedback` RPC asynchronously.

## Privacy boundary (REQ-8)
The feedback payload contains ONLY:
- `event_id` (the event the classifier originally scored)
- `classifier_label` (what the classifier said)
- `classifier_confidence` (the score)
- `moderator_action_kind` (Label / Takedown / NoAction / …)

It does NOT contain:
- Moderator identity
- Moderator reasoning text (sensitive free-text)
- Reporter identity
- Subject content (the classifier already saw it at inference time)

## Rust-quality notes
- **Privacy unit test mandatory**: construct a sample action with all sensitive fields populated; convert to feedback payload; assert via `serde_json::to_string` that no sensitive field name appears in the serialized output. Pattern matches the federation privacy test (#109).
- **Feedback emission is fire-and-forget**: a failed feedback RPC does NOT roll back the moderator's action. Emit on a `tokio::task::spawn` so the action endpoint isn't held by classifier latency.
- **`send_feedback = false` is the default in config** — opt-IN model. Per rust-quality §2: this is a security default; never invert it.
- **A startup banner names every classifier with `send_feedback = true`** so the operator (and a code-reviewer reading logs) can see at a glance which classifiers receive moderator-action data.
- Per rust-quality §3: the feedback function returns `Result<(), ClassifierError>` but the caller (`submit_action`) explicitly ignores the error after a `tracing::warn!` log. Don't propagate; classifier feedback is not action-critical.

## External references
- `tokio::task::spawn` + lifetime considerations: https://docs.rs/tokio/latest/tokio/task/fn.spawn.html
- v1 action-emission entry point: `polaris-backend/src/api/cases.rs::submit_action`
- v1 federation privacy test pattern (reference): TBD in #109

## Acceptance (AC-7)
- [ ] With `send_feedback = false`: take a moderator action; no `Feedback` RPC fires (verified by fixture classifier observing no calls).
- [ ] With `send_feedback = true`: take a moderator action on an event the classifier scored; the Feedback RPC fires with the four allowed fields and no sensitive fields.
- [ ] Privacy unit test in CI on every PR.
